purpose: The ISO 3166-1 codes this project shows, the field each came from and whether it is official. Generated from the pinned source by tools/build_country_codes.py; never edited by hand.

source.dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m Cultural Vectors — Admin 0 Countries
source.licence: Public Domain (Natural Earth Terms of Use)

fields.ISO_A2_EH: the corrected two-letter field (EH = the publisher's fix)

statuses.iso-official: the record's own officially assigned ISO 3166-1 code
statuses.user-assigned: a widely used code that is not officially assigned
statuses.none: the source has no code of this record's own; nothing is invented

ATC.note: the corrected field names the administering state (AU/AUS), not this record; adopting it would duplicate that state's code, so this record keeps no code

FRA.note: taken from the source's corrected ISO_A2_EH/ISO_A3_EH field, where the plain field holds the -99 placeholder

IOA.note: the corrected field names the administering state (AU/AUS), not this record; adopting it would duplicate that state's code, so this record keeps no code

KOS.note: XK is commonly used for Kosovo but is not officially assigned in ISO 3166-1; recorded as user-assigned, never as official. The source gives no three-letter code for Kosovo at all, so none is shown — a gap, not an invention

CYN.note: the source marks it 'Unrecognized' and has no code of its own

NOR.note: taken from the source's corrected ISO_A2_EH/ISO_A3_EH field, where the plain field holds the -99 placeholder

KAS.note: the source marks it 'Unrecognized' and has no code of its own

SOL.note: the source marks it 'Unrecognized' and has no code of its own
